_README: Labels for audio clips fed to the CURRENT MLX Whisper provider by run_stt_eval.py.
'source' is the single most important field here:
human     - a real person speaking. ONLY these count as STT accuracy evidence.
tts       - machine-synthesized speech. A sanity check at best: TTS has no accent,
no background noise, no disfluency and no microphone variation, so it
cannot tell us how Whisper behaves on a real worker's recording.
unlabelled- audio whose intended script was never recorded. Diagnostic only; it can
show WHAT Whisper produced but never whether that was correct.
'path' is relative to evaluation/test_audio/ unless absolute. Missing files are
skipped with a message rather than failing the run.
'expect' lists, per field, the accepted surface forms that count as the information
surviving transcription - e.g. 700 survives as '700', '७००' or 'सातशे'. A field is
'preserved' only if one of its accepted forms appears in the transcript.

clips.tts_command: say -v Lekha -o marathi_english.aiff "<script>" && afconvert -f WAVE -d LEI16@16000 -c 1 marathi_english.aiff marathi_english.wav
clips.tts_voice: Lekha (hi_IN) - macOS ships no Marathi voice, so a Hindi voice reads the Marathi script
clips.intended_script: माझं नाव सुनीता जाधव आहे. मला five years experience आहे electrician म्हणून. मी सध्या Pune मध्ये राहते आणि मला ten thousand rupees expected salary आहे.
clips.notes: Recovered from the earlier STT experiment. NOT accuracy evidence - synthesized speech.

clips.tts_command: say -v Lekha -o hindi_english.aiff "<script>" && afconvert -f WAVE -d LEI16@16000 -c 1 hindi_english.aiff hindi_english.wav
clips.intended_script: मेरा नाम राहुल शर्मा है। मुझे five years experience है plumber के तौर पर। मैं Mumbai में रहता हूं और मुझे fifteen thousand rupees salary चाहिए।
clips.notes: Recovered from the earlier STT experiment. NOT accuracy evidence - synthesized speech.

clips.notes: Does the complete three-part name survive STT? This is the exact failure reported from the browser session.
Marathi hundreds word. In the reported session आठशे was transcribed as आच्छे.

clips.notes: Trade word only. In the reported session it became इलेक्टरिशिंची.
